intents.name: car-finance
examples: What documents are needed for a car loan?
intents.description: Car loan options, down payment, and approval process
intents.answer:
Yes. We work with HDFC, SBI, ICICI, Axis and Bajaj Finance. Down payment from about 10–20% depending on profile. Pre-approval often in 24–48 hours.

Documents needed: PAN, Aadhaar, 3 months’ salary slips (or ITR for self-employed), 6 months’ bank statements, and a cancelled cheque. Our desk helps complete the form.

intents.name: insurance
examples: Do you help with motor insurance?
intents.description: Motor insurance policies and claims assistance
intents.answer:
Yes. We arrange comprehensive and zero-dep policies from leading insurers at the showroom. Multi-year options are available with new car delivery.

For accidents: Our body shop handles denting, painting and cashless claims with empaneled insurers. Bring FIR / claim intimation and policy copy.

intents.name: exchange
examples: Do you accept exchange of my old car?
intents.description: Old car exchange and evaluation process
intents.answer: Yes. We evaluate most running cars free of cost. Bring RC, insurance and PUC. Exchange value is confirmed in writing and adjusted against the new car booking.

intents.name: booking-amount

intents.name: vehicle-specs
examples: What colours are available for the Midsize Sedan?
What is the mileage of the Midsize Sedan petrol?
Is ADAS available on the Compact SUV?
intents.description: Vehicle specifications including mileage, colors, and features
intents.answer:
Midsize Sedan Petrol MT ARAI mileage: ~17.8 km/l (Real-world city: 12–15 km/l).
Colors: Radiant Red, Lunar Silver, Meteoroid Grey, Pearl White, Golden Brown Metallic.
Compact SUV: Popular colours deliver in 2–6 weeks. Select variants offer ADAS (lane watch, adaptive cruise, collision mitigation).
Warranty: Standard manufacturer warranty is typically 3 years / 100,000 km (whichever earlier), with roadside assistance as per policy.

intents.name: service-schedule
examples: How do I book a periodic service?
Which service does my car need?
How much does a Midsize Sedan periodic service cost?
intents.description: Periodic service schedule based on purchase date
intents.answer:
Please provide your purchase/delivery date and current odometer reading. We map this to the schedule:
- ~1 month / 1,000 km: 1st free inspection/PDI (Fluid levels, tyre pressure, basic health check)
- ~6 months / 10,000 km: 1st periodic service (Engine oil + filter, inspection, top-ups)
- ~12 months / 20,000 km: 2nd periodic service (Oil & filter, air filter, brake & underbody)
- ~18 months / 30,000 km: 3rd periodic service (Oil & filter, cabin/air filter, suspension & battery)
- ~24 months / 40,000 km: 4th periodic/major check (Oil, spark plugs, coolant, brake fluid)
- Every 6 months / 10,000 km thereafter: Ongoing periodic service
- Any time after accident/warning light: Repair/diagnosis visit

intents.name: eco-care
intents.description: Tips for fuel efficiency and car care
intents.answer:
• Warm up gently; avoid high RPM for first 1–2 km.
• Smooth throttle & early upshifts save fuel.
• Keep tyre pressure at door-sticker PSI.
• Remove unused roof racks/heavy clutter.
• Use AC wisely (recirculate after cooling).
• Follow service schedule on time.
• Prefer recommended oil grade & genuine filters.
• Idle less than 30–60 seconds when waiting.
• Plan routes to avoid peak congestion.
• Check PUC, battery, coolant monthly.
• Wash with pH-neutral shampoo.
• For long trips: check cold tyre pressure, washer fluid, carry tool kit.
